ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast ratio; interior fluke surface dominated by high-intensity (white) pixels (>90% surface area) bounded by low-intensity (black) pixel borders at the periphery.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity white region spanning both lobes; low-intensity black pigmentation concentrated at the distal tips, the median notch, and the entire trailing edge; one isolated low-intensity dark spot observed on the lower central region of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Narrow, deep U-shaped depression; central notch is well-defined with near-vertical parallel walls at the base and a sharp V-type convergence at the focal point.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern; approximately 18-22 distinct peaks visible along the trailing edge; peaks on the right lobe appear more rounded while the left lobe displays more jagged, irregular amplitudes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Overall horizontal orientation with a slight convex curve across the main body of the lobes, transitioning to a sharp upward concave sweep at the lateral distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct vertical linear dark marking located on the far left distal tip; several faint horizontal striations visible on the lower section of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant vertical linear pigmentation mark or scar on the left fluke tip; irregular jagged notch on the trailing edge of the left lobe approximately one-third the distance from the median notch.
other_distinctive_markers: A singular, isolated dark circular focal spot located in the mid-ventral region of the right lobe.
